references.text: The same chapter describes the number of boards for the south side of the tabernacle, providing context for the six boards on the west side.
Continuation of the instructions regarding the corner boards and their bases on the west side of the tabernacle.
Parallel text describing the actual construction of the six boards for the back of the tabernacle facing west.
God's overarching command to build the sanctuary according to the pattern shown on the mountain.
Solomon's temple also had a rear section (the Most Holy Place), corresponding to the west side of the tabernacle.
Complementary technical detail: Explains the solution for the corners of that same back side (west) mentioned in the source verse.
Structural connection: Describes the bars that stabilize the six western boards mentioned in the source verse.
